Even when adversaries meet, the interaction is weaponized for domestic propaganda rather than genuine conflict resolution.

The plane error is Lyrical vs Physical: using the narrative of "compelling peace" to justify escalatory physical strikes that actually harden adversary resolve.

Actors are locked in a Smart Selfish Loop. They manufacture pretexts of seeking peace while executing high-strain, escalatory maneuvers that project blame onto the opponent, keeping the conflict unresolved to maintain domestic authority.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
German, Russian foreign ministers meet for 1st time since full-scale war against Ukraine

"Russia must end its war of aggression against Ukraine and cease its hostile actions against Germany and its allies," German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said.

Actual Article Body:
The Kyiv Independent Live in London: October 2

Days until event:

German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and his Russian counterpart Sergey Lavrov met on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly on Sept. 26, where Germany called on Russia to end its war and engage in negotiations.

"Russia must end its war of aggression against Ukraine and cease its hostile actions against Germany and its allies," Wadephul said in a post to X after he and his Russian counterpart met for the first time since Russia began its full-scale war against Ukraine.

Stated Claim / Post Context:
How Ukraine’s 40-day summer drone campaign to end the war with Russia backfired

On June 25, at the height of Ukraine’s long-range drone success, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that he had approved a 40-day plan to compel Moscow to end the war through an intensified strike campaign. As part of the surge, Ukraine chose two new strategic targets to ramp up pressure on the Russian populace: Wildberries […]

Actual Article Body:
On June 25, at the height of Ukraine’s long-range drone success, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that he had approved a 40-day plan to compel Moscow to end the war through an intensified strike campaign.

As part of the surge, Ukraine chose two new strategic targets to ramp up pressure on the Russian populace: Wildberries warehouses, Russia’s equivalent to Amazon, and fuel ships supplying Crimea. Kyiv argued the warehouses held dual-use goods, and that hitting them would impose an immediate cost on ordinary Russians, who would pressure the Kremlin to end the war. The shipping strikes aimed to strangle Crimea into an energy and supply crisis.
